mods.name: NovaClient
mods.description: A lightweight FPS client for Minecraft 1.21.1. Works alongside Sodium.

releases.notes:
**NovaClient 0.1.0** — a lightweight FPS client for Minecraft **1.21.1 Fabric**.

> **If you downloaded this before the 12 Sep fix, re-download.** The earlier jar crashed at startup with `InvalidInjectionException` on `FogRendererMixin`. Fixed, and every mixin is now verified against the real class files.

## Install
Drop `novaclient-0.1.0.jar` into `.minecraft/mods` alongside Fabric Loader 0.16.3+ and Minecraft 1.21.1. No Fabric API required. Works together with Sodium — this client does not replace the renderer.

Open the GUI with **Right Shift**. Config saves to `novaclient.json`.

## What's in it
71 modules across 6 tabs: Performance, Render, Visual, HUD, Player, Misc.

- **Motion Blur** — a real post-processing chain that blends each frame with the previous one, live Amount slider, In Menus Only mode
- 14 HUD widgets: FPS, CPS, Ping, Coords, Direction, Biome, Clock, Memory, Server IP, Keystrokes, Module List, Armor, Potions, Reach
- Renderer mixins for entity culling, fog, low fire, hand FOV, item physics, the water/pumpkin/portal overlays, hide sky, inventory move and auto tool
- Feather-style click GUI with per-tab counts, inline settings and search

## Verified
`verify-mixins.sh` javaps every `@Inject`/`@Redirect` target and fails if a handler's static-ness disagrees with it. 19 injections, 0 problems.

## Removed rather than faked
- **Fast Math** — no API without a coremod
- **Resolution Scale** — needs renderer hooks that collide with Sodium (the reference mod, RenderScale, requires eight mixins plus dedicated Sodium and Iris compatibility layers)

Nothing here has been measured on a device or in a real client session beyond the crash that was reported and fixed.
